Applicant :- Uday Pratap
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Sunita Chauhan,Ajay Kumar Pandey,Sheshadri Trivedi Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Vivek Kumar Singh Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
Sri Vivek Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the informant has sent his illness slip, which is taken on record.
Sri Sheshadri Trivedi, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Pradeep Kumar, learned AGA for the State-respondent are present.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 362 of 2020, under Sections 304B, 498A IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Civil Lines, District Etawah, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

Learned Senior Counsel, Sri Satish Trivedi appearing on behalf of the applicant submitted that applicant is husband and cause of death is strangulation and trial of the case is at advance stage and therefore, it would be appropriate that trial court be directed to conclude the trial within three months.

sentences.text: Learned AGA is having no objection.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

As trial of the case is at the stage of section 313 Cr.P.C., therefore, I find force in the submission made by learned counsel for the applicant that at this stage, it would not be appropriate for this Court to enter into the merit of the case and accordingly, the instant bail application stands rejected.

However, considering the fact that the trial of the case is at advanced stage, trial court is directed to conclude the trial of the case within four months from the date of production of certified copy of this order.

It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
